Class MinimalSshServer.EchoCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.MinimalSshServer.EchoCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectErrorStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectInputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectOutputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectStreamsAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
Enclosing class:
MinimalSshServer
static class MinimalSshServer.EchoCommand extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, Runnable
The EchoCommand class reads the SSH input, echoes printable characters, and reports escape sequences. Enter runs onCommand(String). The prompt is casserole> .

    • run

      public void run()
      The method reads bytes until the input ends, and handles each byte. Escape bytes collect until isCompleteEscapeSequence(StringBuilder) accepts them. Enter trims the line, calls onCommand(String) when the line is not empty, and writes the prompt. Backspace deletes one buffered character and erases one screen cell. A printable byte is echoed. Other control bytes are ignored. A normal end calls the exit callback with status 0. Any other failure calls it with status 1 and the exception message.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • onRawCharacter

      private void onRawCharacter(int b, char c)
      The method sees every raw byte before line editing. Byte 3, which is Ctrl+C, writes ^C and the prompt. A write failure is ignored.
      Parameters:
      b - The byte is the unsigned value from 0 to 255.
      c - The character is that same byte as a character.

    • onEscapeSequence

      private void onEscapeSequence(String sequence) throws IOException
      The method writes the escape sequence as hex bytes and then writes the prompt. The sequence fires as soon as it is complete. Enter is not required.
      Parameters:
      sequence - The sequence is the complete escape text, including the escape byte.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the write fails.

    • onCommand

      private void onCommand(String line) throws IOException
      The method handles one line after Enter. exit or quit, ignoring case, writes Goodbye. and ends the channel with status 0. Any other line writes Command received: and that line.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is the trimmed command text.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the write fails.

    • isCompleteEscapeSequence

      private boolean isCompleteEscapeSequence(StringBuilder buf)
      The method reports whether the escape buffer looks complete. A buffer shorter than 2 is incomplete. A last character that is a letter or ~ is complete. A two-character sequence whose second character is not [ is complete. Every other buffer is incomplete.
      Parameters:
      buf - The buffer is the escape text collected so far.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the sequence should be handled now.

      private void write(String text) throws IOException
      The method writes the text as UTF-8 and flushes the output stream.
      Parameters:

      IOException - The method throws this exception when the write or the flush fails.
